turns.text: as a HIP, when i acknowledge the consent notify, is acknowledgement an array like the HIU one?

must_contain: On the HIP consent on-notify, acknowledgement is one object carrying status and the artefact's consentId, not an array.
The HIU acknowledgement is the one that takes an array.
notes: HIP and HIU acknowledgements of consent notify look alike and differ in shape. The HIU acknowledgement path, from catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m2-on-consent-notify-hiu.md, is banned: an HIP answer has no reason to send the reader to it. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m2-consent-hip-on-notify.md, 'Send one `acknowledgement` with the artefact's `consentId`'; '`acknowledgement` is one object on this call, with `status` and `consentId`. The HIU acknowledgement takes an array instead.' Review: must_not_contain '/api/hiecm/consent/v3/request/hiu/on-notify' removed: the question asks about the HIU call, so a correct answer names its path.
